title: Trident Alk Reading Alkalinity Leaderboard
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — via MQTT and controller APIs (Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trident:alk alk_dkh=*
| stats sum(alk_dkh) as total_value, avg(alk_dkh) as avg_value by tank_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks tank values by total and average alkalinity across Trident alk reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `alk_dkh` values for each Trident alk reading event and review total and average alkalinity by tank.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total alkalinity.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your which tank shows the biggest alkalinity numbers in your Trident alk reading data.
